title: Unique Values in Order
prompt: A signup form may receive the same interest more than once. Write a function that returns the array with duplicates removed while keeping the first occurrence of each value in its original order.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Unique Values in Order, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A signup form may receive the same interest more than once. Write a function that returns the array with duplicates removed while keeping the first occurrence of each value in its original order. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in JavaScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
